english.title: Fail to produce registration book / document for inspection
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in respect of which a registration document had been issued, failed to produce the said registration document for inspection upon being required at a reasonable time to do so by a

(A)_[police officer]_
(B)_[person acting on behalf of the Secretary of State]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12 of the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(b) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
